title: Postgres databases
description: Per-app view of the shared Postgres cluster: pick the app's role (its databases follow) or databases directly. All panels read the primary. Provisioned from git (kube-cluster/apps/grafana/dashboards/postgres); README there has the runbook.

panels.title: Databases
panels.description:
One row per selected database, now (rates over 5 min, deadlocks over the time range). Click a name to show only that database below. Sort by *Busy* to find the app loading the database.

- **Busy**: average backends executing statements (seconds of work per second).
- **Read wait**: seconds per second spent reading blocks; needs `track_io_timing`.
- **Idle in tx**: oldest transaction left open by an idle client; it blocks vacuum.

targets.expr: max by (datname, owner) (cnpg_pg_database_owner_info{namespace="postgres", pod="$primary", datname=~"$database", owner=~"$role"})
max by (datname) (cnpg_backends_max_tx_duration_seconds{namespace="postgres", pod="$primary", datname=~"$database", state=~"idle in transaction.*"})

sum by (datname) (rate(cnpg_pg_stat_database_xact_rollback{namespace="postgres", pod="$primary", datname=~"$database"}[5m])) / (sum by (datname) (rate(cnpg_pg_stat_database_xact_commit{namespace="postgres", pod="$primary", datname=~"$database"}[5m])) + sum by (datname) (rate(cnpg_pg_stat_database_xact_rollback{namespace="postgres", pod="$primary", datname=~"$database"}[5m])))

sum by (datname) (rate(cnpg_pg_stat_database_blks_hit{namespace="postgres", pod="$primary", datname=~"$database"}[5m])) / (sum by (datname) (rate(cnpg_pg_stat_database_blks_hit{namespace="postgres", pod="$primary", datname=~"$database"}[5m])) + sum by (datname) (rate(cnpg_pg_stat_database_blks_read{namespace="postgres", pod="$primary", datname=~"$database"}[5m])))

panels.title: Backends by state
panels.description: Client backends of the selected databases on the primary, by state.

panels.title: Backends by database
panels.description: Client backends per selected database.

panels.title: Backends by application
panels.description: Backends by the `application_name` the client sets (empty for most apps).

panels.title: Backends by role
panels.description: Backends by login role. A role other than the database's owner is an app with the wrong credentials or a shared database.

panels.title: New sessions
panels.description: Connections opened per second. Each forks a backend; a steady stream means the app does not pool connections (or its pool keeps reconnecting).

panels.title: Sessions ended abnormally
panels.description: Sessions per second ended by a vanished client (*abandoned*), a fatal error, or termination.

panels.title: Commits and rollbacks
panels.description: Transactions per second.

panels.title: Busy backends
panels.description: Statement execution time per second: how many backends were working on average. Compare with the cluster's total on the Postgres dashboard.

panels.title: Cache hit ratio
panels.description: Share of block reads served from shared_buffers. Low with a high *Read wait*: the database's working set does not fit in memory.

targets.expr: sum by (datname) (rate(cnpg_pg_stat_database_blks_hit{namespace="postgres", pod="$primary", datname=~"$database"}[$__rate_interval])) / (sum by (datname) (rate(cnpg_pg_stat_database_blks_hit{namespace="postgres", pod="$primary", datname=~"$database"}[$__rate_interval])) + sum by (datname) (rate(cnpg_pg_stat_database_blks_read{namespace="postgres", pod="$primary", datname=~"$database"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Read wait
panels.description: Seconds per second spent reading blocks from outside shared_buffers (needs `track_io_timing`), and the mean time per block.

targets.expr: sum by (datname) (rate(cnpg_pg_stat_database_blk_read_time{namespace="postgres", pod="$primary", datname=~"$database"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (datname) (rate(cnpg_pg_stat_database_blks_read{namespace="postgres", pod="$primary", datname=~"$database"}[$__rate_interval])) / 1000

panels.title: Rows by operation
panels.description: Rows read and written per second, all selected databases. *returned* far above *fetched*: sequential scans, a missing index.

panels.title: Temp file bytes
panels.description: Bytes per second spilled to temp files by sorts and hashes larger than `work_mem` (4 MB).

panels.title: Transaction and statement age
panels.description: Oldest open transaction (*active*, *idle in tx*) and longest running statement.

targets.expr: max by (datname) (cnpg_backends_max_tx_duration_seconds{namespace="postgres", pod="$primary", datname=~"$database", state=~"idle in transaction.*"}) > 0

panels.title: Locks and deadlocks
panels.description: Backends waiting for a lock, and deadlocks per interval.

panels.title: Top statements
panels.description:
The statements with the most execution time over the selected range: the top 5 of each selected database by cumulative time, plus *other* for the rest of that database. *Share* is the part of its database's execution time.

Statements are identified by `queryid` only; an admin reads the text in psql on the primary, in the statement's database: `SELECT query FROM pg_stat_statements WHERE queryid = <id>;` (`kubectl -n postgres exec -it <primary> -c postgres -- psql -d <database>`). Statistics live on the primary only and start over after a switchover.

targets.expr: (sum by (datname, queryid) (rate(cnpg_pg_stat_statements_top_total_exec_time{namespace="postgres", datname=~"$database"}[$__range])) / 1000 / on (datname) group_left() sum by (datname) (sum by (datname, queryid) (rate(cnpg_pg_stat_statements_top_total_exec_time{namespace="postgres", datname=~"$database"}[$__range])) / 1000)) and on (datname, queryid) topk(50, sum by (datname, queryid) (rate(cnpg_pg_stat_statements_top_total_exec_time{namespace="postgres", datname=~"$database"}[$__range])) / 1000)

sum by (datname, queryid) (rate(cnpg_pg_stat_statements_top_calls{namespace="postgres", datname=~"$database"}[$__range])) and on (datname, queryid) topk(50, sum by (datname, queryid) (rate(cnpg_pg_stat_statements_top_total_exec_time{namespace="postgres", datname=~"$database"}[$__range])) / 1000)

(sum by (datname, queryid) (rate(cnpg_pg_stat_statements_top_total_exec_time{namespace="postgres", datname=~"$database"}[$__range])) / sum by (datname, queryid) (rate(cnpg_pg_stat_statements_top_calls{namespace="postgres", datname=~"$database"}[$__range]))) and on (datname, queryid) topk(50, sum by (datname, queryid) (rate(cnpg_pg_stat_statements_top_total_exec_time{namespace="postgres", datname=~"$database"}[$__range])) / 1000)

(sum by (datname, queryid) (rate(cnpg_pg_stat_statements_top_rows{namespace="postgres", datname=~"$database"}[$__range])) / sum by (datname, queryid) (rate(cnpg_pg_stat_statements_top_calls{namespace="postgres", datname=~"$database"}[$__range]))) and on (datname, queryid) topk(50, sum by (datname, queryid) (rate(cnpg_pg_stat_statements_top_total_exec_time{namespace="postgres", datname=~"$database"}[$__range])) / 1000)

sum by (datname, queryid) (rate(cnpg_pg_stat_statements_top_shared_blks_read{namespace="postgres", datname=~"$database"}[$__range])) and on (datname, queryid) topk(50, sum by (datname, queryid) (rate(cnpg_pg_stat_statements_top_total_exec_time{namespace="postgres", datname=~"$database"}[$__range])) / 1000)

(sum by (datname, queryid) (rate(cnpg_pg_stat_statements_top_temp_blks_written{namespace="postgres", datname=~"$database"}[$__range])) * 8192) and on (datname, queryid) topk(50, sum by (datname, queryid) (rate(cnpg_pg_stat_statements_top_total_exec_time{namespace="postgres", datname=~"$database"}[$__range])) / 1000)

panels.title: Execution time by statement
panels.description: Seconds of execution per second, the 15 largest statements of the selection (*other* included). Statements are identified by `queryid` only; an admin reads the text in psql on the primary, in the statement's database: `SELECT query FROM pg_stat_statements WHERE queryid = <id>;` (`kubectl -n postgres exec -it <primary> -c postgres -- psql -d <database>`). Statistics live on the primary only and start over after a switchover.

panels.title: Mean time per call
panels.description: Average execution time per call, the 15 slowest statements of the selection. A step up with unchanged calls: a plan change or a missing index.

targets.expr: topk_max(15, sum by (datname, queryid) (rate(cnpg_pg_stat_statements_top_total_exec_time{namespace="postgres", datname=~"$database", queryid!="other"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (datname, queryid) (rate(cnpg_pg_stat_statements_top_calls{namespace="postgres", datname=~"$database", queryid!="other"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Calls by statement
panels.description: Executions per second, the 15 most frequent statements of the selection. A statement called thousands of times per second is often an N+1 loop in the app.

targets.expr: topk_max(15, sum by (datname, queryid) (rate(cnpg_pg_stat_statements_top_calls{namespace="postgres", datname=~"$database", queryid!="other"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Blocks read by statement
panels.description: Blocks per second the 15 heaviest readers fetched from outside shared_buffers.

targets.expr: topk_max(15, sum by (datname, queryid) (rate(cnpg_pg_stat_statements_top_shared_blks_read{namespace="postgres", datname=~"$database", queryid!="other"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Size
panels.description: Size on disk.

panels.title: Growth per day
panels.description: Size change per day from the trend over the last day.

panels.title: Transaction ID age
panels.description: Age of the oldest unfrozen transaction ID. Autovacuum freezes at 200M; staying high means something blocks vacuum (a long transaction).

panels.title: Pooler clients
panels.description: Clients of the selected databases on `postgres-pooler`, active and waiting. Empty for apps that connect to `postgres-rw` directly.

panels.title: Pooler query time
panels.description: Mean query time and mean wait for a server connection, per database, as pgbouncer measures them.

targets.expr: sum by (database) (rate(cnpg_pgbouncer_stats_total_query_time{namespace="postgres", pod=~"$pooler", database=~"$database"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (database) (rate(cnpg_pgbouncer_stats_total_query_count{namespace="postgres", pod=~"$pooler", database=~"$database"}[$__rate_interval])) / 1e6

sum by (database) (rate(cnpg_pgbouncer_stats_total_wait_time{namespace="postgres", pod=~"$pooler", database=~"$database"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (database) (rate(cnpg_pgbouncer_stats_total_query_count{namespace="postgres", pod=~"$pooler", database=~"$database"}[$__rate_interval])) / 1e6

panels.title: Pooler max wait
panels.description: Longest current wait for a server connection.

targets.expr: max by (database) (cnpg_pgbouncer_pools_maxwait{namespace="postgres", pod=~"$pooler", database=~"$database"} + cnpg_pgbouncer_pools_maxwait_us{namespace="postgres", pod=~"$pooler", database=~"$database"} / 1e6)
